events.name: Bash
events.head: Show task pass status, pro page files, price table, and git layout
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -30; ls app/src/app/\(site\)/pro/ app/scripts/ app/src/lib/ | head -120; cat app/src/lib/prices.json; git status --short | wc -l; git -C app rev-parse --show-toplevel; git remote -v

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the Dodo setup script and size the pro page files
events.input: $ wc -l app/src/app/\(site\)/pro/* app/scripts/dodo-setup.mjs app/src/lib/currency.ts app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts && cat app/scripts/dodo-setup.mjs && git diff --stat -- 'app/src/app/(site)/pro' app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check existing Pro price table, recent commits, uncommitted diffs and publish holds
events.input: $ ls app/src/lib/ | grep -i -E 'price|currency|dodo|checkout'; cat app/src/lib/prices-pro.json 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -8 -- 'app/src/app/(site)/pro' app/scripts/dodo-setup.mjs app/src/lib/prices-pro.json app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts; echo ---; git diff -- 'app/src/app/(site)/pro' app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts; echo ---; grep -n -i -E 'n8n|webhook|50M|cohort|fetch\(' app/src/app/\(site\)/pro/*; echo; grep -n '"T-071"' -A3 workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json | head; grep -c . workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md; grep -n -i 'publish held\|T-071\|/pro' workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the earlier T-071 commit, push state and related task logs
events.input: $ git show --stat 255576b | head -40; git branch -vv | head -5; git log origin/main --oneline -1; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD | wc -l; git branch -r --contains 255576b | head; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read T-071's current state, both feedback notes and the pro probe header

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the pro probe against the live mirror and grep the pro page for banned content
events.input: $ cd app && BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site node scripts/probe-pro.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "exit=$?"; git grep -n -i -E 'n8n|50M|3-month|cohort' HEAD -- 'src/app/(site)/pro' | head; grep -rn -i -E 'n8n|50M|3-month|cohort|—|–' 'src/app/(site)/pro' | head; git merge-base --is-ancestor 255576b origin/main && echo "rebuild is in origin/main"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Record the verification note on T-071 and acknowledge the feedback note
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-071 status=review note="Re-run of note F-43b6a66f: nothing left to build, the earlier run already did all of it (commit 255576b, now in origin/main). Re-verified today: probe-pro.mjs passes every check on the live mirror, where US, DE and IN visitors see \$999, €997 and ₹99,999 and Dodo's hosted checkout for pdt_0NpKlRqJAjyAf3axboQSR shows the same amounts; app/src/app/(site)/pro has no n8n, \$50M+ or cohort copy. Open https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/pro/?v=t071b . The newer Orchestrator

events.text: T-071 stays in review: note F-43b6a66f was already fully carried out by an earlier run (rebuild commit 255576b is on origin/main, the Dodo product exists), and today's re-run of `probe-pro.mjs` passes every check on the live mirror at https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/pro/?v=t071b; the newer Orchestrator note F-71dc8ef6 is still unread and was not part of this run.
